conditions.notes: ASM-0002 assumes independent review-and-merge can serve as the acceptance map without distorting intent. Two thirds of that mapping are enforced by the substrate; the independence third has no enforcing mechanism in the repository. The assumption is not refuted — it may hold by convention — but it is load-bearing and unanchored, which the assumption's own wording does not disclose.
